title: Adding Outdoor and Indoor Sports Halls of Institutes of Technical Education and Institutes of Higher Learning to Dual-Use Scheme
what_it_is: Adding Outdoor and Indoor Sports Halls of Institutes of Technical Education and Institutes of Higher Learning to Dual-Use Scheme

sections.label: IHL sports and facility rentals
sections.summary: Some IHL sports facilities are under the Dual-Use Scheme or open to public, and some IHLs rent out facilities outside teaching hours.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: For example, tennis and badminton courts in the National University of Singapore are part of the Dual-Use Scheme (DUS), while several stadium-based running tracks in our other IHLs are open to public during operating hours.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Outside of regular teaching hours, some IHLs do rent out their facilities.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: For example, lecture theatres and classrooms for continuing and education training, programmes that are run by external training providers or events.

sections.label: IHL facility use and leasing
sections.summary: IHL sports facilities may be heavily used after hours, and some IHLs lease non-sports facilities to external providers or on request.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: Other sports facilities in our IHLs could be heavily utilised by students, staff, alumni and their community partners after school hours and even on weekends, for co-curricular activities and campus events.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: An important consideration for whether these facilities are suitable to be placed under the DUS for public use, would be whether there are physical boundaries that allow separate access points to the sports facilities.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: As for non-sports facilities, Temasek Polytechnic and the Nanyang Technological University lease their facilities to external training providers to run private programmes.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: Nevertheless, members of public or other organisations may approach our IHLs directly to request to lease lecture theatres, classroom facilities for activities – Healthier SG included – if they wish to.
